name: gmail-otp-filler
description: Automatically extracts verification codes from Gmail and fills them into web forms.

scripts.build:firefox: rm -rf dist/firefox && mkdir -p dist/firefox/icons && cp background.js content.js popup.js popup.html popup.css dist/firefox/ && cp icons/icon16.png icons/icon48.png icons/icon128.png dist/firefox/icons/ && cp manifest-firefox-mv3.json dist/firefox/manifest.json && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --warnings-as-errors
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --filename otp-filler-gmail-firefox-1.2.1.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --channel unlisted --api-key "$AMO_API_KEY" --api-secret "$AMO_API_SECRET"
